dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Zinnia arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Zinnia has been observed to be fearful. Noted to have a tense body and retreat from handlers when they approach. She is also noted to growl at handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Zinnia
